jobs_results.job_title: Math, Accounting, Computer Science, Data Analyst Background Wanted — $80,000/Year
jobs_results.description:
Do you enjoy spreadsheets, analyzing information, solving problems, and figuring out the most efficient way to accomplish something?




Royal Maintenance Group is a fast-growing national contracting and property services company operating across 27 states, and we're looking for a highly analytical person to join our team.




You do not need previous estimating or industry experience.




We are specifically interested in candidates with backgrounds or strong interests in areas such as:

MathematicsAccountingFinanceComputer ScienceEngineeringEconomicsData AnalyticsBusiness Analytics


What Will You Actually Be Doing?




Your job will be to help us figure out what projects should cost.

Our company manages large commercial projects throughout the country. Before we can price a project for a customer, someone needs to analyze the property, determine what resources will be required, calculate costs, and make sure the project can be completed profitably.

That's where you come in.




You will analyze information such as:

Property sizes and measurementsLabor requirementsMaterial costsEquipment requirementsVendor and subcontractor pricingMaps and property layoutsHistorical project dataProject specificationsProfit marginsCustomer requirements


You'll then use that information to build accurate estimates and pricing models.

Think of the position as a combination of math, business analysis, problem solving, and project strategy.




What We're Looking For:

We care much more about how you think than whether you've worked in our industry before.




You may be a great fit if:

You're naturally good with numbersYou're extremely detail-orientedYou enjoy solving complicated problemsYou're very comfortable using computersYou're strong with Excel or spreadsheetsYou can look at a lot of information and make sense of itYou notice details other people missYou learn new systems quicklyYou're organizedYou're comfortable making decisionsYou take ownership of your workYou're ambitious and want to grow


Previous estimating or construction experience is NOT required.

We will teach you our industries and how our projects work.

We're looking for someone who can bring the analytical ability.




The Projects:

You'll work on pricing projects for major commercial properties throughout the United States.

Depending on the season and division, projects may involve:

Snow and ice managementCommercial roofingProperty maintenanceFacility servicesOther commercial contracting services


One day you might be analyzing the cost to service a portfolio of commercial properties during a snowstorm. Another day you might be speaking with subcontractors executing the operations.

The industries change.




The underlying job is the same: analyze the project, understand the numbers, and determine what it should cost.




Compensation

$80,000 per year

Full-time position.

Monday through Friday

8:00 AM – 4:00 PM

Hoboken Office

1 Newark Street

Hoboken, NJ 07030




Our office is located just steps from the Hoboken PATH station, making it extremely convenient from Manhattan and throughout North Jersey.

Free parking is also available at a nearby parking garage.

No Industry Experience? That's Okay.

We're not necessarily looking for someone who already knows our business.

We're looking for someone who is smart, analytical, curious, and capable of learning it.

You'll get exposure to how a large national company prices projects, evaluates profitability, manages vendors, makes operational decisions, and grows into new markets.




Career Growth

We're looking for someone who can eventually become much more than an entry-level analyst.

As you learn the business and demonstrate your abilities, there may be opportunities to advance into:

Senior EstimatingBusiness AnalyticsPricing StrategyProject ManagementOperationsDivision ManagementSenior Management


Royal Maintenance Group is continuing to expand, and we want ambitious people who are interested in growing alongside the company.




If you're highly analytical, great with numbers, and looking for something more entrepreneurial and hands-on than a traditional accounting or corporate analyst position, we'd like to hear from you.

jobs_results.job_title: Senior Associate, Data Scientist - Model Risk Audit
jobs_results.description:
Data is at the center of everything we do. As a startup, we disrupted the credit card industry by individually personalizing every credit card offer using statistical modeling and the relational database, cutting edge technology in 1988! Fast-forward a few years, and this little innovation and our passion for data has skyrocketed us to a Fortune 200 company and a leader in the world of data-driven decision-making.
As a Data Scientist at Capital One, you’ll be part of a team that’s leading the next wave of disruption at a whole new scale, using the latest in computing and machine learning technologies and operating across billions of customer records to unlock the big opportunities that help everyday people save money, time and agony in their financial lives.
As part of Capital One’s Model Audit team, you will have a unique vantage point to review models and model risk practices across the enterprise and the opportunity to connect the dots to raise the appropriate model risk issues and provide assurance to the Audit Committee. Successful candidates will partner cross-functionally with business throughout the company to deliver breakthrough analytical solutions to support a winning strategy in a continually changing business environment. You will be the driving force to experiment, innovate, and create next-generation features powered by the latest emerging NLP and Generative AI technologies. If you love a fast-paced, highly rewarding environment, and you love being a builder and communicator, this is the place for you.
In this role, you will:
Partner with a cross-functional team of data scientists, software engineers, and product managers to deliver a product customers love
Leverage a broad stack of technologies - Python, Conda, AWS, H2O, Spark, and more - to reveal the insights hidden within huge volumes of numeric and textual data
Build machine learning models through all phases of development, from design through training, evaluation, validation, and implementation
Flex your interpersonal skills to translate the complexity of your work into tangible business goals
The Ideal Candidate is:
Innovative. You continually research and evaluate emerging technologies. You stay current on published state-of-the-art methods, technologies, and applications and seek out opportunities to apply them. 
Creative. You thrive on bringing definition to big, undefined problems. You love asking questions and pushing hard to find answers. You’re not afraid to share a new idea. 
A leader. You challenge conventional thinking and work with stakeholders to identify and improve the status quo. You’re passionate about talent development for your own team and beyond. 
Statistically-minded. You’ve built models, validated them, and backtested them. You know how to interpret a confusion matrix or a ROC curve. You have experience with clustering, classification, sentiment analysis, time series, and deep learning. 
Basic Qualifications:
Currently has, or is in the process of obtaining one of the following with an expectation that the required degree will be obtained on or before the scheduled start date:
A Bachelor's Degree in a quantitative field (Statistics, Economics, Operations Research, Analytics, Mathematics, Computer Science, or a related quantitative field) plus 2 years of experience performing data analytics
A Master's Degree in a quantitative field (Statistics, Economics, Operations Research, Analytics, Mathematics, Computer Science, or a related quantitative field) or an MBA with a quantitative concentration
Preferred Qualifications: 
Master’s Degree in “STEM” field (Science, Technology, Engineering, or Mathematics), or PhD in “STEM” field (Science, Technology, Engineering, or Mathematics)
Experience working with AWS
At least 2 years of experience in Python, Scala, or R
At least 2 years of experience with machine learning
At least 2 years of experience with SQL
